summary: Purchase 30 UpScope remote support seats + SCIM/SSO onboarding for Support & Platform
description:
Issue summary:
Request to buy 30 UpScope (cobrowsing + session recording) seats for Support and Platform teams, and complete SSO (OIDC/SAML) and SCIM provisioning.

Business impact:
- Support CSAT expectation: faster issue triage using cobrowse.
- Currently reps use screen-sharing with permission overhead; UpScope would reduce mean time to resolution for account-level troubleshooting by reducing screen-share setup time.
- No production runtime changes; this is a procurement + identity integration request.

Requested deliverables:
- Purchase approval for 30 paid seats (annual subscription) charged to cost center ENG-SUPPORT-Q2.
- Signed DPA and SOC2 evidence on file.
- SCIM group mapping for two groups: support-core, platform-oncall.
- Enable SSO via SAML with automated provisioning and deprovisioning.

Environment:
Internal SaaS (vendor-hosted). No changes to customer-facing infra.

Steps to reproduce / action list:
1. Confirm business owner approval (Support manager).
2. Vendor procurement: collect quote, invoicing, DPA and FedTax/W-9.
3. Security review: verify retention policy and session recording encryption.
4. IdP integration: configure SAML settings + SCIM tokens; map groups.
5. Finance: accept invoice or use company P-card.
6. Enable seats and validate provisioning with a pilot group (5 users) then roll out.

Attachments / references:
- Vendor quote URL: https://upscope.example.vendor/quote/RED-2026-03 (internal link placeholder)
- Support business case doc: confluence.redwood/support/upscope-business-case (see related_confluence_pages)

Expected timeline:
- Approvals: 3 business days after procurement and security checks.
- Integration and pilot: 1 week after SSO/SCIM creds available.

Acceptance criteria:
- 30 seats granted and assigned to support-core and platform-oncall groups.
- SCIM automatically provisions/deprovisions users based on group membership.
- Session recordings are encrypted at rest and retention policy documented in security artifact store.

investigation_notes: Vendor supports SAML SSO and SCIM API. License SKU: UpScope Support Pro - annual. Preliminary pricing matches quote: $9/user/month billed annually (approx $3,240/year for 30 seats). Security requested SOC2 Type II, DPA, and explicit retention controls for session recordings. Identity team noted SCIM attribute mapping: email, displayName, groups. Need test account from vendor to validate SCIM delta sync behavior.
resolution: Pending approvals and vendor artifacts. Next steps: procurement to collect DPA and SOC2 report, finance to issue PO or P-card, identity to receive SCIM token and configure group mapping, pilot roll-out to 5 users, then full seat assignment. Post-procurement follow-up ticket will track SCIM mapping verification and retention documentation.
